name: Verizon Wireless
notes: Private home domain vzims.com and ePDG wo.vzwwo.com, not the 3GPP discovery names. The P-CSCF comes from the ePDG tunnel (SWu-IKEv2 prints it).

The ePDG authenticates with EAP only (RFC 5998), no certificate, and answers IDr ims as topon.<node>.epc.mnc480.mcc311.3gppnetwork.org. It assigns an IPv6 address and three IPv6 P-CSCFs over the tunnel.

Identities are built from the IMSI and MSISDN (IMPI <IMSI>@vzims.com, IMPU sip:+1...@vzims.com) and IMS AKA runs on the USIM (identity/aka_app "usim"): that is what has been tested. The iOS bundle says USIMFallbackSupport false, so the ISIM may work too, but that is untested.
REGISTER uses IMS-AKA with algorithm=AKAv2-MD5, no sec-agree/IPsec on Gm. The network grants 7200 s whatever Expires asks for.
+sip.instance must carry the IMEI of the device the SIM is actually in (here the modem); reusing another handset's IMEI breaks calls.
Outgoing calls: the reliable 183 carries the SDP answer, then a 180 and 200 OK without SDP (handled by the early media workaround in main.cpp).
BYEs must carry Reason "User Triggered", P-Access-Network-Info and P-Preferred-Identity, or Google Pixels and LTE-attached SIMs get stuck (src/bye_reason.cpp).

SMS arrives as SIP MESSAGE with application/vnd.3gpp2.sms (C.S0015), from tel:910090009000;phone-context=vzims.com. Needs +g.3gpp.smsip in the Contact. Sent SMS go out in 3GPP2 format too (sms.format), to that same address (sms.smsc).

Use UDP. Over TCP the P-CSCF drops the registration's connection and network-initiated requests (incoming SMS, the SMS delivery report) never arrive, so outgoing SMS and calls work but nothing comes in.
Keep sip_port at 5060: with the contact on another port, registration, SMS and in-dialog requests still work, but Verizon never sends incoming calls (callers get voicemail).
